property.name: note
property.value:
Where music progression lays, Uses Horizantal value between 0-10 to progress the music 1- leave intro 2 - leave main to motif 3 - return from Breakdown to main 4 - To solo section 5 - Cancels attraction from magnet 6 - Back to breakdown from solo 7 - Stops "Boss" magnet 8 - From Breakdown to Chorus 9 - Back to main altarnative 10 - Boss
Boss parameter activates guitars and increases the audio for lead synth.
